youtube.description:
Claude Code plan mode: Claude explores and proposes a plan, you approve, then it builds. 3 steps.

Claude Code plan mode: 3 steps before any code changes. Stop it from rushing in.

1. Switch - Press Shift+Tab until plan mode shows, or run /plan.
2. Review - Claude explores and proposes. Nothing gets edited.
3. Approve - Edit the plan, approve it, then let it build.

Needs: Pro, Max or Console

Official docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes
